title: The Hourglass Chamber
story: Deep under the dunes, Hassaleth the Hourglass Wyrm has tipped the great sand funnel over the Temple of Echoes, and three lantern-dancers are stranded on a ledge inside. Sand pours into the chamber at 7.5 inches every minute. Mr 6 wrenches open a floor grate that pulls sand out at 4.5 inches every minute, then sets to work prying the stone door.
question: The sand is 21 inches below the dancers' ledge. How many minutes does Mr 6 have before the sand reaches the ledge?
solution: The sand really climbs by 7.5 - 4.5 = 3 inches each minute.
praise: Dividing by a rate was exactly the right move — the missing step was subtracting the drain so you divide by the REAL climb each minute.
hint: Sand is pouring in and draining out at the same time. Find how much the sand level truly gains in one minute first.
victory: Mr 6 popped the door with six seconds to spare, and the dancers slid out on a river of sand. Hassaleth, now an hourglass with nothing to measure, curled up and took a nap.
imagePrompt: A golden-scaled sand wyrm coiled around a giant hourglass funnel inside a torchlit desert temple, sand streaming down while a small knightly numeral 6 with a blue cape heaves at a stone door below a crowded ledge.
